text:
jordan_dev: heads up — main CI turned red right after #4821 merged. runtime-inference/integration job failing on kvcache test. job: https://ci.internal/red/23345

samir_infra: thanks. can you paste the failing test name + last few lines of the log?

jordan_dev: failing test is `tests/integration/test_kvcache_eviction.py::test_eviction_under_load`
log snippet:
```
E       AssertionError: expected cache size 0, got 3
runtime/inference/cache_manager.py:214: AssertionError
Build step 'Run pytest -k kvcache' returned exit code 1
```

olivia_sre: pinging infra oncall — @samir_infra assigning bisect? if it's a flaky reg, we should rerun first.

samir_infra: I'll kick a rerun now. if it stays red, we bisect. starting quick rerun for job 23345 -> 23346.

ci-bot: rerun started by samir_infra (job 23346). ETA ~10m. :hourglass:

lina_qa: note that test occasionally flakes when eviction policy timing aligns with high latency kernels. not sure if new kernel commit in #4821 touched that code but worth checking. cc @mike_release (author of merged PR).

mike_release: I merged #4821 (kv-cache eviction tweak) — didn't see failures in my local run. i'll look at the diff now, but if rerun passes feel free to close.

ci-bot: rerun finished: job 23346 FAILED (same test). Log: `AssertionError: expected cache size 0, got 2`

samir_infra: ok that's consistent. starting a bisect on main between pre-merge (commit a1b2c3) and post-merge head (commit d4e5f6). Will report candidate commit.

olivia_sre: if bisect points to #4821 we can do a hotfix revert or quick patch. try to reproduce locally with stress harness: `python tests/integration/test_kvcache_eviction.py::test_eviction_under_load -k stress --runs=50`

jordan_dev: running stress now on a small shard, will report. can someone grab the test invocation from CI container? it uses `--timeout 300` and `PYTEST_ADDOPTS='-q'` per job config.

mike_release: I'm on it, looking at my change — I adjusted eviction window from 50ms -> 30ms to reduce memory spikes. possible race. if bisect blames my PR I'll open a rollback.

lina_qa: small tactical ask: can we mark the test flaky and mute it for a short window on main to restore green? prefer to avoid long slowness but we need quick availability for other merges.

samir_infra: agree to mute for now if bisect doesn't give immediate culprit. I'll post a short revert if bisect pins #4821.

jordan_dev: thanks everyone. updating the PR thread and tagging QA. I'll paste any local repro logs here in ~15m. :thumbsup:
